steps.name: Medea's Memories (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Medea] in 「Kali」, then find [Jenna] in 「Zisk Plains」.

lines.text: (Medea gazes at the sky, repeatedly turning an object over in her hands. When %s comes into view, she offers a warm smile.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I've been waiting for you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Did your conversation with Lady Iris go well? I trust you enjoyed a good meal at the Snowflower Inn, too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I was very hungry. What did you want to see me about?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I want to tell you something about my past that Lady Iris does not know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure you're ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It pains me to speak of Weiss' atrocities again, but Lady Iris must know even this.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That knowledge will help her save many lives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Lady Medea's eyes look so sad...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please follow me.

steps.name: Medea's Memories (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Lethe of Oblivion] in 「Lake of Oblivion」 and obtain <Tear of Illusion>. Then turn in the quest to [Jenna] in 「Zisk Plains」.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jenna. Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm always doing well here. Though I do wish I could leave the estate...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother and you visit often, Lady Iris speaks to me sometimes, and the Algea here play with me. I'm happy.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: ...That ominous presence and the unpleasant feeling in the estate are clearly gone now...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You and my brother must have resolved something very serious.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hello, Lady Jenna. Lord Ziskad has told me about you. It's a pleasure to meet you. I am...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Those ears... Are you... Lady Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You know me?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Yes. I know you're a Champion like my brother. And I feel as though we met long ago. Oh, perhaps I only saw you from a distance.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry I didn't recognize you...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It's all right. What brings you here, though...
(Jenna notices something glowing faintly in Medea's hand.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I think I've seen something similar farther along the lakeshore. I couldn't do anything with it, so I left it there...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. It will help both me and Lady Iris.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Will it? Then bring it to me when you find it. Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because of my people...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It wasn't your fault, Lady Medea. That witch was responsible.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then we'll be back. Come, %s. Let's find the Tear of Illusion by the lake...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand...

steps.name: Medea's Memories (3)
steps.objective: Have the conversation in a quiet spot in 「Zisk Plains」, then turn in the quest to [Jenna].

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Did you find it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, thanks to you. And to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can hardly take credit. It was easy to spot at the far end of the lakeshore... What do we do now?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Follow me. You can talk there. I may have something to tell you as well.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: This way, please.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I understand...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The murky presence no longer hangs over this lakeshore. Weiss vanished, along with the power of Purgatory...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: No more people will die unjustly, will they?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll all do everything we can to prevent it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We must...
(Medea carefully studies the Tear of Illusion in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: When you came to the Zisk Plains and learned the truth about me, Adventurer, a few more memories returned to me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: They concern the Kali tribe. Lady Medea coming here with you is probably no coincidence.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No, these things do not happen by chance. Now, then...
(Medea breaks off a piece of the Tear of Illusion and drops it. Beneath the tip of her staff, the fragment turns to powder and scatters.)
(In the distance, someone's form emerges as a hazy shadow.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Father...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I never thought I'd see this scene again. But it seems a little different from before...)

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: Ungrateful wretch! All I did was help your people escape persecution by the Deimos Order and the kingdom... Why must we...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am grateful for your help, my lord. But your kingdom has done something it should never have done.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You made contact with another 'witch.' And she must have demanded something from you.

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: ...What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The Kingdom of Howl seeks a witch's power... In that case, your efforts to help us have come to nothing...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You have ended up helping Weiss, who tried to kill my people...

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: Can you truly not give up being a 'witch'?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I have no choice. For my own survival, for my people's... And for the child whose fate is like mine, yet somewhat different...

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: ...That child, Medeia. How many times has she opened her eyes again? When Jenna looked after her...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You knew? Then I cannot let you live...

lines.speaker: 영주
lines.text: Witch! I will curse you to the end, even in death! I should never... never have let you... near us...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am sorry.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: For our people to survive, this child must grow stronger. How much longer will it take for a child born to a witch's life to become complete...?
(The lord's figure scatters like sand and vanishes. Weiss' image appears beside Daphne. Their words continue on separate subjects, never quite forming a conversation.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Medeia, my beloved child...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I need the power of the Kali tribe's pure souls. Do not stand in my way, Oathbreaker!!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I made the mistake of helping you for a moment, but things will not go as you wish.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Somehow the former god learned of it and sealed Coral City. I could have used that foolish fishman king...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Still, this will do. With this much life force, and that of the Kali tribe...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: My precious child, as dear as my own soul, as though you were part of me.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Oathbreaker... That was not in our contract. Why will you not let me kill Daphne?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Because that is what the one I serve wishes.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: An obstacle... If I cannot kill her, I must cast her into the rift between time and space...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This magic stone...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A magic stone filled with life force that may or may not belong to the Kali tribe. Why do you need it...?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Medeia... I did not vanish because I wanted to... Medea...
(Daphne's figure disappears from the vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: It seems Daphne intended us to see that.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shall we return to the lakeside?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now that I understand everything, I'll collect my thoughts and explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm all right...
(With a faint smile as if to reassure you, Medea walks ahead.)

steps.name: Medea's Memories (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Zisk Plains Algea] in 「Zisk Plains」 to obtain <Zisk Blueberries>. Then return to [Jenna] and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: So much has happened.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I understand...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To you as well as me, Lady Jenna...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I've put my thoughts in some order. Let me explain now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure you're ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all right, %s.
(Medea drops the Tear of Illusion. Her staff strikes down hard, shattering the vessel of Daphne's memories.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I no longer need this. I think I understand what I am now. Though I cannot say how many lives I have lived...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The Kali tribe's souls are purer than those of other humans. Pure enough to form the foundation of Weiss' magic stones...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She wanted to protect our people, but when the lord who had helped us discovered she was a witch, she made a terrible mistake.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Even as she insisted that our people were human... she abandoned her own humanity and chose a witch's life...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then, in the name of protecting our people, she struck a bargain with Weiss.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She did terrible things to the lord, to Lord Ziskad and Lady Jenna... and to every living being on the estate. I am sorry.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That was not your fault, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's right. So please...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: But I think I was part of the reason she did it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? You, Lady Medea?
(Medea raises her head and quietly looks at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know when I was first born... But I died when I was twelve. Many other Kali children died as I did.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Children were born only to die, and those still living suffered Weiss' attacks... As a last resort, she made a deal with him...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If she dealt with the Zisk estate, he would give her magic stones brimming with life force...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Some of the dying children survived as a result. In the process, she discovered that I was destined to become a witch.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know if she wanted me to awaken as a witch and remain at her side, or if she wanted something else.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: With the stones' power, their life force, the children gradually became able to live. But Beinan and I alone kept dying and awakening again...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Our memories were erased... Each time I was given a new life, I believed it was all there was. She must have thought it was for the best.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The village elders had some idea back then. Why I had to live... Why she kept bringing me back...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then she disappeared. Perhaps Weiss sent her somewhere...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: With our leader gone, the Deimos Order attacked us. In that crisis, our people made a final choice, unaware that it was the wrong one...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To save me, believing I would protect the tribe, the elders threw themselves into the vortex of mana that guarded Kali Village.
(Overcome by emotion, Medea begins to sob. The adventurer and Jenna comfort her and wait.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm sorry... May I lie down for a moment?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Of course. Please rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea, please rest, as Jenna says.
(Jenna watches the resting Medea with concern.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: There was something good for calming the emotions... Oh!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, could you find some blueberries on our estate?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Blueberries?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Zisk Blueberries are very soothing for both body and mind. Chase away the Algea and you should find some easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be right back!

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: You're back, Adventurer. Were there any blueberries?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. There were some left where the Algea were. Lady Medea, these should help you feel calmer.
(You bring a richly purple blueberry to Medea's lips. Its sweet fragrance draws her eyes open.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is...
(After carefully tasting the blueberry, Medea reaches a hand toward %s.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: May I have some more?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes... I recognize this taste.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Blueberries from the Zisk Plains... They taste just like the ones we harvested in Kali. Perhaps they were grown here as part of our exchange...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, I remember too. When I was little, the farmers were delighted with a new kind of fruit.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It hurts to think how a relationship with such promise was destroyed... Though the estate's blueberries are a little sweeter.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: They would make a liquor Lord Ziskad would enjoy... Hehe...

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I'm glad you're feeling better. Would you like to rest a little more?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...No. I must finish telling what I know, so Lady Iris and Lord Ziskad can understand as well.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please don't look at me like that. This is a story I must tell...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hmm. Where was I?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, the elders... With the power of those who willingly returned themselves to life force, I was able to protect some of our people, including the young children.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In doing so, I was led back toward death. The magic stones had only prolonged my life a little...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Her sins, and the memories of certain others... Perhaps of witches...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At that moment, I was able to live again. I did not die. I learned later that it was the blessing of Lady Gaia, who had awakened then.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A fate neither she nor I had known... That from then on I would live as both witch and Champion...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is something I haven't told you. During these events, I gave Lady Iris the divine power I had received from Lady Gaia. For her sake...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Lady Medea!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That does not mean I will live as a witch. My trust in the divine will only grow stronger. Lady Iris will watch over me...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No more Champions with fates like mine should have to appear in this land...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's all right. I have already escaped that curse of death, through the power of Perse that Shynic shared with me... And that is the end of my story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you, Lady Jenna.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Not at all. You've helped me understand my own memories, too. Thank you for telling us, for my sake and my brother's.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Medea...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Champions all bore such fates... Will things really be all right now? Lady Medea still has...)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Lady Medea... I wish I could hug you, but with this body...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then would you sing for me instead? Lord Ziskad kept boasting about 'our Jenna.' I've wanted to hear you.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Oh, my brother... I'm not that good, but... I have a song I've been practicing. I'll sing it for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd love to hear it too, Jenna.
(Jenna nods with a radiant smile, then closes her eyes and steadies her breathing.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: May my song reach you... ♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Beneath the same sky, as I wished and wished... ♬
(Jenna's song continues, wishing happiness for everyone. Little by little, the unease in Medea's heart flows away into the Lake of Oblivion.)
